summary_en: 5,600,000 shares to be cancelled (0.9% of issued shares ex-treasury), effective 2025-03-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 612,391,000; treasury stock: 12,821,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Kajima Corporation announced on the date of this disclosure that its board of directors has resolved, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, to cancel 5,600,000 treasury shares held by the company. The cancellation represents 0.9% of the issued shares (ex-treasury) as of the filing date. The cancellation is scheduled to be effective on 31 March 2025. Post-cancellation, the company will have 612,391,000 issued shares outstanding and 12,821,000 shares remaining in treasury. The reference figures and percentages reflect the treasury position as of the board meeting date; any changes to treasury stock occurring between the filing date and the scheduled cancellation date are not included in these calculations.
